sql: select 'fill' k, f.market_ticker m, f.filled_at::text t, o.action||' '||o.side||' lim '||o.limit_price||' fill '||f.side||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity v from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-23 09:40' union all select 'ord', market_ticker, created_at::text, left(coalesce(client_order_id,''),9)||' '||action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity||' '||status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'') from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-23 09:40' or status in ('resting','partial','submitted') or market_ticker in ('KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT27-NQE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC')) union all select 'pos', market_ticker, captured_at::text, quantity_fp::text from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from positions where market_ticker in ('KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT27-NQE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC') order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) p union all select 'snap', market_ticker, at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker in ('KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT27-NQE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC') and at > now()-interval '3 hours' order by market_ticker, at desc) s order by 1,2,3
